sentences.text: The CMC investigated alleged misconduct involving the 2004 Gold Coast City Council election and reviewed the adequacy of local government laws.
sentences.support: The inquiry was also required to examine the adequacy of existing legislation

sentences.text: It examined candidate links, campaign donations, electoral bribery and councillors’ handling of personal interests.
sentences.support: declaring and dealing with conflicts of interest or material personal interests

sentences.text: The Commission found that candidates had made false or misleading statements to conceal a shared campaign fund backed by developers.
sentences.support: in a concerted effort to conceal the existence of a group of candidates being funded from a common developer-backed fund.
sentences.section: PART A: SUMMARY OF FINDINGS FOR first TERM OF REFERENCE

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that the conduct harmed the election’s integrity, while the specific conflict cases examined could not amount to offences under the Act.
sentences.support: none of the specific cases of alleged conflicts of interest examined could amount to offences under that Act.
sentences.section: PART A: SUMMARY OF FINDINGS FOR first TERM OF REFERENCE

sentences.text: The Commission made 19 recommendations covering donation disclosure, conflicts of interest, enforcement, council decision records and protection for council employees.
sentences.support: Recommendation 19: That the LGA be amended to make it an offence to breach section 230(2) of the LGA
sentences.section: PART B: SUMMARY OF RECOMMENDATIONS FOR second and third TERMS OF REFERENCE

findings.quote: The Commission is satisfied that there were a number of false or misleading statements made to the media in this matter in a concerted effort to conceal the existence of a group of candidates being funded from a common developer-backed fund.
Because of the narrow definition of ‘material personal interest‘ under the LGA, none of the specific cases of alleged conflicts of interest examined could amount to offences under that Act.
